summary: This impressive four-bedroom detached home offers an exceptional standard of living, providing generous and versatile accommodation perfectly suited to families of all ages. INCENTIVES AVAILABLE
description:
Thoughtfully designed with modern family life in mind, the property combines spacious interiors with a practical layout, ensuring both comfort and functionality throughout. At the heart of the home lies a stunning open-plan kitchen, dining, and family area, beautifully designed to create a bright and sociable space. Featuring contemporary finishes and expansive double doors, this inviting area opens directly onto the private rear garden, allowing for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining, this space forms the true focal point of the home. The ground floor further benefits from a separate snug lounge, offering a cosy and more intimate retreat, along with a practical utility room and a convenient cloakroom/W.C. Enhancing the home's functionality, there is also an integral double garage, providing secure parking and additional storage, complemented by useful under-stairs storage space. To the first floor, the property continues to impress with four well-proportioned bedrooms, each offering comfortable and flexible living accommodation. Two of the bedrooms enjoy the added luxury of their own dressing areas and stylish en-suite shower rooms, creating private and well-appointed spaces for relaxation. The remaining bedrooms are served by a modern and well-designed family bathroom, catering perfectly to the needs of a busy household. Externally, the property benefits from a block-paved driveway providing ample off-road parking, alongside a beautifully landscaped and fully enclosed rear garden. This private outdoor space offers an ideal setting for entertaining, family activities, or simply unwinding in a peaceful environment. This outstanding home truly offers everything required for contemporary family living, combining space, style, and practicality in an enviable setting. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality and lifestyle on offer.

THE DEVELOPMENT Life at Westpark Garden Village offers a superb balance of convenience, community, and outdoor living, making it an desirable setting for modern family life. Ideally positioned, the development allows residents to enjoy a wealth of amenities quite literally on the doorstep, with Westpark Village just a short stroll away. Here, you'll find an excellent selection of everyday essentials and lifestyle conveniences, including a café, bakery, Marks & Spencer, and Aldi, alongside a welcoming local pub-perfect for relaxed family meals or socialising with friends. Everything you need is within easy reach, enhancing both practicality and quality of life. For those who appreciate the outdoors, Westpark is particularly appealing. A network of scenic walking routes weaves throughout the area, offering the perfect setting for morning strolls, dog walking, or simply unwinding in nature. The nearby park provides a tranquil escape, where you can take in picturesque surroundings before heading home-ideal for balancing work and leisure, especially for those working remotely. Community lies at the very heart of Westpark Garden Village, creating a welcoming and family-friendly environment where neighbours quickly become familiar faces. Whether it's enjoying the green open spaces, visiting local amenities, or simply embracing the relaxed pace of life, this is a location designed to enrich everyday living.

LOCAL AREA Westpark is an ongoing development and a thriving community made up of residential homes and a vibrant commercial village centre. Amenities include an M&S Foodhall, Aldi supermarket, Convenience store, Bakery, Café, Hair and Beauty salon, Dentist, Pharmacy and The White Heifer that Travelled Pub. There is also an excellent Primary and Children's nursery school plus Westpark Hospital. It is enhanced further by thirty-three acres of stunning open Parkland to explore and enjoy. Juniper Avenue is directly adjacent to the earlier phases of Westpark and is located on the northeast side of Edward Pease Way. The western and northern boundaries of the development are adjacent to the A1(M) and A68 providing excellent links to the transport networks. The East Coast mainline is perfect for those needing to commute for work or leisure. The local bus services run frequently into Darlington Town Centre and beyond.
